svg.aria-label: Core logic of the UA Student Budget Tracker
svg.text: UA Student Budget Tracker — Core Logic
The main purpose in one schematic: turn a plan into measured, visible spending — while there is still time to act.
A student sets a plan → every peso is recorded → the system measures the gap continuously → the student and the office act before the allowance runs out.
THE CORE PURPOSE — ONE REPEATING LOOP
Sets the budget: amount, period type,
Records income and every expense, with
Reads the alerts and decides: trim
Waits for approval — the account cannot
sign in until it is active.
Every income and expense enters the
ledger as it happens: amount, date,
State = On track · Near limit · Over
decision: trim spending, or adjust the
Spending inside the live window is
added up, then compared with the
The loop repeats inside every window (live window):
1 Plan → 2 Record → 3 Measure → 4 Act → adjust the plan (gold arrow) — then the next window
A clear remaining balance and an early
warning — so the allowance lasts to the
end of the period, not just the first
A worst-first view of who is
overspending, and the evidence to guide
them before it becomes a problem.
A4-printable reports and CSV exports for
parents, projects and audits — the same
THE DATA BEHIND IT — SHARED, SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
Both sides read the same tables, so the figure a student sees and the figure the office sees are always the same number — no separate ledgers, no reconciliation.
7-day cycle from the chosen start day
Every window rolls over automatically: midnight, the chosen weekday, and the 1st of the month.
THE THREE STATES THE ENGINE RETURNS
under the alert threshold — green bar
threshold reached, still under 100% — amber bar + warning
100% or more — red bar, negative remainder, always alerted
